```yaml
name: Document Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fetch-and-commit-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.MESHERY_CI }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.24"

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq curl

      - name: Fetch Latest Community Post
        id: fetch_post
        run: |
          # Fetch the latest post from the community category
          POST_DATA=$(curl -s "https://discuss.layer5.io/c/community/6/l/latest.json")
          
          # Extract the latest post ID and title
          POST_ID=$(echo "$POST_DATA" | jq -r '.latest_posts[0].id')
          POST_TITLE=$(echo "$POST_DATA" | jq -r '.latest_posts[0].title')
          
          # Extract the raw content
          POST_CONTENT=$(echo "$POST_DATA" | jq -r '.latest_posts[0].content')
          
          # Save to variables
          echo "post_id=$POST_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "post_title=$POST_TITLE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "post_content=$POST_CONTENT" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Meeting Minutes File
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          
          # Sanitize filename
          FILENAME=$(echo "${{ env.post_title }}" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/_/g' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
          FINAL_FILENAME="${TIMESTAMP}-${FILENAME}.md"
          
          # Write content to file
          cat > ".github/meetings/archive/$FINAL_FILENAME" << EOF
          ---
          title: ${{ env.post_title }}
          date: $TIMESTAMP
          ---
          
          ${{ env.post_content }}
          EOF
          
          echo "filename=$FINAL_FILENAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "ci@meshery.io"
          git config --local user.name "meshery-ci"
          
          git add .github/meetings/archive/${{ env.filename }}
          
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Auto-commit: Add meeting minutes for ${{ env.post_title }}" || echo "Commit failed, but continuing..."
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }} || echo "Push failed, but continuing..."
          fi
```
